lessons_used: sign_in, copy changes consistently worked, winning both tests with an average noise-corrected lift of +3.1%.
home, new_flow changes consistently failed, showing negative impacts across 2 tests (-2.6% average after noise correction).
home, wait_info changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests (+2.3% average after noise correction).

candidates.title: Account Recovery & Sync Sign-In Copy
candidates.change: Clarify on the sign-in screen that logging into an existing account immediately restores previous pets and saved progress.
candidates.why: 8 support emails reported missing or reset pets after signing back in, and previous sign_in copy changes showed a consistent +3.1% lift.

sign_in.headline: Welcome Back to Your Desktop Pet
sign_in.body: Sign in to instantly restore your pets, custom traits, and saved items across your devices.

guard.reason: Copy update on sign-in screen is valid and does not violate any rule.

candidates.score_note: High support volume (8 emails) and sign_in copy changes have a proven track record (+3.1% average).

candidates.title: Pet Certificate Signature Badge Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate layout into a two-column view featuring an animated mascot preview and verified badge.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest step conversion rate (66.0%) and high completion time (median 89s / mean 1017s).

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.replace.certificate[0]': a mascot cannot do the certificate job (use ['animation', 'badge', 'image', 'preview', 'text'])

candidates.title: Reordered Late Account Creation Flow
candidates.change: Move the sign-in screen to occur after pet selection and certificate adoption so users establish an account after building attachment to their pet.
candidates.why: Requiring sign-in before pet selection creates upfront friction, contributing to drop-offs before users customize their pet.

guard.reason: Moving sign-in after adoption certificate is explicitly permitted by onboarding reordering rules.

candidates.score_note: Flow restructuring carries high implementation cost and structural flow changes tend to fail or add friction.

candidates.title: Desktop Placement Verification Hint
candidates.change: Display an explicit positioning hint during the setup waiting screen explaining where the pet widget will anchor on the screen.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported that pets did not appear on the desktop or that the app stalled during setup.

waiting.hint: Your pet will anchor to the bottom-right corner of your desktop taskbar once setup completes.

guard.reason: Adding a placement hint on the waiting screen is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Backed by 3 support emails, but home wait/hint changes have shown modest or neutral past results.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Companion Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated checklist screen (new_desktop_guide) detailing shortcut keys and desktop interaction options right before finishing.
candidates.why: 3 support messages cited confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to their desktop pet after completing onboarding.

new_desktop_guide.headline: How to Interact with Your Pet
new_desktop_guide.body: Learn how to control and summon your desktop companion at any time.

components.text: Right click pet for menu; Drag to move across monitors; Double click to speak

guard.reason: Adding a new companion screen for desktop controls prior to home intro is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses support complaints on desktop pet controls, though creating a new screen requires full release effort.

candidates.title: Path Selection Interactive Carousel Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign path selection into an interactive carousel view featuring choice cards and preview animations.
candidates.why: Choose path has a high mean duration (514s vs 8s median), indicating hesitation among undecided users.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Custom Pet Creation Step Guide New Flow
candidates.change: Insert a pre-upload step guide screen (new_custom_builder) providing photo quality requirements before custom pet creation.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures and rendering errors.

new_custom_builder.headline: Custom Pet Creation Guide
new_custom_builder.body: Follow these guidelines for optimal custom pet generation results.

components.text: Use clear front-facing lighting; Ensure subject is centered; Avoid blurry backgrounds

guard.reason: Inserting a new custom builder guide screen before photo upload is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Targets the highest drop-off step (adoption, 34% lost), but introducing new_flow screens historically regressed conversion.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Interaction Tip Carousel
candidates.change: Add a hint on the home intro screen providing key shortcuts for summoning and interacting with the desktop pet.
candidates.why: Post-onboarding confusion regarding hiding and talking to pets generated multiple support requests.

home_intro.hint: Pro tip: Hover over your pet to check stats or press Alt+P to summon it anywhere on screen.

guard.reason: Adding an interaction hint to the home intro screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses post-onboarding confusion with low friction UI hint, though evidence on hints remains mixed.

candidates.title: Instant Sign-In Benefit Headline Copy
candidates.change: Update the sign-in headline and body text to highlight multi-desktop pet sync and data protection.
candidates.why: Sign_in copy improvements have historically delivered a +3.1% lift, and account loss concerns are a top support theme.

sign_in.headline: Sync Your Companion Across Desktops
sign_in.body: Connect your account to keep your pet's personality, accessories, and memory safe on any PC.

guard.reason: Updating sign-in text to highlight sync capabilities is valid and compliant.

candidates.score_note: Zero code cost copy update on sign_in, supported by top support themes and consistent past copy test wins.
